sentences.target: I'm thinking about trying that new Italian place for dinner.
sentences.en: I'm thinking about trying that new Italian place for dinner.
sentences.es: Estoy pensando en probar ese restaurante italiano nuevo para cenar.
sentences.fr: Je pense à essayer ce nouveau restaurant italien pour le dîner.
sentences.pt: Estou a pensar em experimentar aquele novo restaurante italiano para o jantar.
sentences.kr: 저녁으로 그 새로운 이탈리안 식당에 가 보려고 생각 중이에요.
sentences.zh: 我在考虑晚餐去那家新开的意大利餐厅试试。
sentences.jp: 夕食に、あの新しいイタリア料理店に行こうかと考えているんだ。

sentences.target: Oh, I've heard good things about it! Are you in the mood for pasta?
sentences.en: Oh, I've heard good things about it! Are you in the mood for pasta?
sentences.es: ¡Ah, he oído cosas buenas de él! ¿Te apetece pasta?
sentences.fr: Oh, j'ai entendu de bonnes choses à ce sujet ! Tu as envie de pâtes ?
sentences.pt: Oh, já ouvi boas coisas sobre ele! Estás com vontade de massa?
sentences.kr: 아, 좋은 얘기 들었어요! 파스타가 땡기세요?
sentences.zh: 哦，我听说那家店很不错！你想吃意大利面吗？
sentences.jp: ああ、あそこはいいって聞いたよ！パスタが食べたい気分なの？

sentences.target: Actually, I was hoping to get a pizza with lots of toppings.
sentences.en: Actually, I was hoping to get a pizza with lots of toppings.
sentences.es: En realidad, esperaba pedir una pizza con muchos ingredientes.
sentences.fr: En fait, j'espérais prendre une pizza avec beaucoup de garnitures.
sentences.pt: Na verdade, esperava comer uma pizza com muitos ingredientes.
sentences.kr: 사실은 토핑이 많은 피자를 먹고 싶었어요.
sentences.zh: 其实，我想点一个料很多的披萨。
sentences.jp: 実は、トッピングがたくさん乗ったピザが食べたいと思っていたんだ。

sentences.target: That sounds great. I prefer a thin crust with just mushrooms.
sentences.en: That sounds great. I prefer a thin crust with just mushrooms.
sentences.es: Suena genial. Yo prefiero una masa fina solo con champiñones.
sentences.fr: Ça a l'air super. Je préfère une pâte fine avec juste des champignons.
sentences.pt: Isso parece ótimo. Eu prefiro massa fina só com cogumelos.
sentences.kr: 그거 좋네요. 저는 버섯만 올린 얇은 도우를 좋아해요.
sentences.zh: 听起来不错。我更喜欢薄饼底，只要蘑菇的。
sentences.jp: いいね。私は薄い生地で、マッシュルームだけのものがいいな。

sentences.target: Good choice. We can get one with half mushrooms and half pepperoni.
sentences.en: Good choice. We can get one with half mushrooms and half pepperoni.
sentences.es: Buena elección. Podemos pedir una con la mitad de champiñones y la otra mitad de pepperoni.
sentences.fr: Bon choix. On peut en prendre une avec la moitié aux champignons et l'autre moitié au pepperoni.
sentences.pt: Boa escolha. Podemos pedir uma com metade cogumelos e metade chouriço.
sentences.kr: 좋은 선택이에요. 버섯 반, 페퍼로니 반으로 시키면 돼요.
sentences.zh: 好选择。我们可以点一个一半蘑菇一半意大利辣香肠的。
sentences.jp: いい選択だね。半分マッシュルーム、半分ペパロニのを頼めるよ。

sentences.target: Perfect. I'll make a reservation for us.
sentences.en: Perfect. I'll make a reservation for us.
sentences.es: Perfecto. Haré una reserva para nosotros.
sentences.fr: Parfait. Je vais réserver pour nous.
sentences.pt: Perfeito. Vou fazer uma reserva para nós.
sentences.zh: 太好了。我来帮我们订个位。
sentences.jp: 完璧だね。予約しておくよ。
